## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering change.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] `pnpm package`
- [ ] Relevant `MANUAL_QA.md` scenarios, when page interaction or recovery behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation, permissions, protocol/runtime revisions and changelog are synchronized

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No prompts, answers, private code, ChatGPT URLs, account identifiers, cookies or tokens are included
- [ ] No new workspace read/write, command execution, network or Chrome permission surface was added without explicit review
